none: PAS NLM-4C798C: Roman Coin: Dupondius of an indeterminate Early Roman ruler
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Dupondius of an indeterminate Early Roman ruler; about two thirds of flan is lost. Suggested date: 43-200. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: [IM]P C(---). Reverse description: probably female figure standing left. Diameter (in excess of): 20.6mm, Weight: 1.78gms, die axis: probably 6
